name: anthropic-dev-kit
description: Build MCP servers that expose your APIs to agents, test web applications with Playwright, and design frontends that do not look generated. The Apache-2.0 skills from Anthropic's public skills repository.

safety.warning: The mcp-builder evaluation harness calls every tool of the server under test, write tools included, and its HTTP server example listens on every network interface without authentication.
safety.covered: The security-defaults rule keeps servers you write on 127.0.0.1 and requires your yes before a write tool runs; point the harness at a sandbox account or at read-only tools.
